stories.title: Federal government cancels National Teachers Institute admissions
stories.summary: The Federal Ministry of Education has cancelled all 2026 admissions for the National Teachers Institute, citing regulatory breaches in accreditation and university affiliations. The ministry stated the institute is not authorised to award degrees or NCE certificates, and directed it to discontinue all existing university partnerships immediately.

stories.title: Woman accused of cheating school in CBSE affiliation fraud
stories.summary: A woman identified as Mansi Patil is accused of cheating a Chembur school of 7 lakh rupees by promising to secure CBSE affiliation. The school administrator, currently operating under the Maharashtra State Board, filed a police complaint after the promised board recognition failed to materialise. Investigation is underway.

stories.title: Delhi schools shift to hybrid mode as air quality worsens
stories.summary: Schools in Delhi and five neighbouring cities have been directed to conduct classes up to Class 5 in hybrid mode. The move follows the invocation of Stage III restrictions under the Graded Response Action Plan as air quality reached the severe category ahead of the Diwali festival.

stories.title: Nanjing University drops AI attentiveness tracking
stories.summary: Nanjing University has stopped using AI software to track student attentiveness after leaked screenshots revealed the system monitored a head-up rate in classrooms. The university had introduced the technology to record attendance and map engagement, but removed the features following a public backlash from the student body.

stories.title: Parents sue Google over school Chromebook usage
stories.summary: Parents of a 13-year-old girl have filed a lawsuit against Google, alleging the company is liable for a psychological crisis linked to her school-issued Chromebook. The case claims the device facilitated access to AI tools, marking a rare legal challenge against technology hardware used in American classrooms.

stories.title: Telangana High Court questions CBSE over textbook mandates
stories.summary: The Telangana High Court has questioned the CBSE regarding its failure to act on complaints that affiliated schools force parents to buy non-NCERT textbooks. A parent petition alleges that schools like Don Bosco in Motinagar impose unauthorized curricula. The court is now reviewing the board's oversight practices.

stories.title: Bihar government restricts social media use for school staff
stories.summary: The Bihar government has banned teachers and students from filming or uploading social media reels without official permission. This follows a new formal dress code introduced in late October. The state currently manages over 76,000 government schools and employs 6.6 lakh teachers across the region.

stories.title: Odisha plans drug-free zones around schools
stories.summary: The Odisha government plans to declare a 500-metre radius around all educational institutions as drug-free zones. The initiative aims to curb the sale of narcotics near campuses by combining enforcement measures with awareness programmes, covering schools, colleges, universities and technical institutes under the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.

stories.title: Himachal Pradesh chief minister announces new CBSE school
stories.summary: Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced that a CBSE-affiliated school will become functional in Mehla village starting next academic session. The announcement was made during the Sarkar Gaon Ke Dwaar programme, where the chief minister also detailed a new monthly financial assistance scheme for eligible women.

stories.title: Pune to open eight CBSE-affiliated civic schools
stories.summary: The Pune Municipal Corporation has received government approval to launch eight CBSE-affiliated schools starting in the 2027 to 2028 academic year. The initiative aims to provide English-medium education to approximately 17,000 students. The city will now operate within the central board framework for these selected locations.

stories.title: Jharkhand aspirants protest following exam result allegations
stories.summary: Following the Jharkhand Public Service Commission exam results in July, aspirants have raised concerns over the integrity of the selection process. Allegations surfaced after an OMR sheet appeared on social media showing low marks for a successful candidate. The commission has not yet addressed the circulating claims.

stories.title: CBSE sets practical exam dates for winter-bound schools
stories.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education has released the practical exam schedule for winter-bound schools. Assessments, projects, and internal evaluations for Class 10 and Class 12 are set to take place from November 9 to December 19, 2026. Students can view the full timetable on the official website.

stories.title: CBSE releases practical exam schedule for winter-bound institutions
stories.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education has published the practical exam and internal assessment dates for winter-bound schools for the 2026 to 2027 academic year. Evaluations are scheduled to run from November 9 through December 19, 2026. The circular applies exclusively to schools in winter-bound regions.
